package rulefixtures

	"net/http"
	"time"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"

// scenario for repeated_large_map_literal_response_construction: Large map-literal response assembly on hot routes where a stable typed response would be cheaper.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func scenario335Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
		"status":      "ok",
		"code":        200,
		"message":     "request processed",
		"timestamp":   time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
		"environment": "production",
		"region":      "us-east-1",
		"request_id":  "abc-123-def",
		"version":     "2.4.1",
		"pagination": gin.H{
			"page":       1,
			"page_size":  50,
			"total":      243,
			"total_pages": 5,
		},
		"links": gin.H{
			"self":  "/api/v1/items",
			"first": "/api/v1/items?page=1",
			"last":  "/api/v1/items?page=5",
		},
	})
}
